chunks: Ibn Udhaynah narrated from Zurārah, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about al-qasāmah, and he said: “It is true and established.

A man from the Anṣār was found slain in a well among the wells of the Jews. So they came to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, we found one of our men slain in a well among the wells of the Jews.’ He said: ‘Bring me two witnesses from other than yourselves.’ They said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, we do not have two witnesses from other than ourselves.’ So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to them: ‘Then let fifty men from among you swear against one man, and we will hand him over to you.’ They said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, how can we swear to what we did not see?’ He said: ‘Then the Jews shall swear.’ They said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, how can we accept the Jews, while what is in them of shirk is greater?’ So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم paid his blood-money.

Zurārah said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: ‘Al-qasāmah was only instituted as a precaution for the blood of the Muslims, so that when a wicked person wishes to kill a man where no one sees him, he will fear that and refrain from killing.’

key_terms.الْفَاسِقُ: a wicked or openly sinful person
key_terms.الْقَسَامَةِ: the legal procedure of repeated oaths in a murder case when full proof is unavailable
key_terms.دَمِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the protected blood and lives of the Muslims
key_terms.شَاهِدَيْنِ: two witnesses required as evidentiary proof
key_terms.فَوَدَاهُ: he paid the blood-money for him
key_terms.قَتِيلًا: a slain person; someone found killed

ai.seo_question: Why was al-qasāmah instituted in Islamic law for murder cases?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the legal validity of al-qasāmah in cases of suspected murder when direct evidence is lacking. It recounts a precedent from the time of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and explains that this ruling was established to safeguard Muslim lives and deter secret killing.
